map.7.5 kW 电机实心轴校核: Check a 7.5 kW motor solid shaft
map.：7.5 kW、1450 r/min 电机轴，实心轴径 d=25 mm，45 钢: : A 7.5 kW, 1450 r/min motor shaft with solid diameter d=25 mm in 45 steel at [τ]=35 MPa. T=9549×7.5/1450=49.4 N·m; Jp=π·25⁴/32=3.835×10⁴ mm⁴; r=12.5 mm; τ=T·r/Jp=49.4×10³×12.5/3.835×10⁴=16.1 MPa < 35 MPa, so it is safe.
map.实心轴与空心轴怎么选？: How Do You Choose Between a Solid and a Hollow Shaft?
map.同质量下空心轴抗扭惯性矩更大、刚度更高，适合对重量敏感场合（航空、汽车传动）；但: At equal mass a hollow shaft has a larger torsional moment of inertia and higher stiffness, suiting weight-sensitive applications (aerospace, automotive drivelines); but hollow shafts cost more to make and risk instability, so ordinary machinery prefers solid shafts.
map.许用切应力取多少？: What Allowable Shear Stress Should I Use?
map.45 钢调质约 30–40 MPa，Q235 约 20–25 MPa，合金钢可达: Quenched and tempered 45 steel is about 30–40 MPa, Q235 about 20–25 MPa, and alloy steel can reach 50–80 MPa; combine these with the heat treatment and a safety factor for the conditions.
